title: Employee Benefits Guide
body: Sample Corp benefits: medical (two PPO plans, one HDHP with company HSA contribution), dental, and vision, all effective day one. 401(k) with a 4% company match, vested immediately. $1,500/year learning and development stipend. Annual open enrollment runs in November; life events (marriage, new child, relocation) qualify for a 30-day special enrollment window outside that. Questions go to Dana Okafor or the benefits inbox.
